mapper.sql:
SELECT r.target_name AS targetName, r.nickname AS nickname, r.update_time AS updateTime, i.standard_name AS standardName, r.task_id AS taskId, r.task_name AS taskName, COUNT(1) AS totalItemCount, SUM(CASE WHEN i.error_value_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS abnormalItemCount, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i.error_value_flag = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(1), 2) AS abnormalRate FROM inspect_record_item i JOIN inspect_record r ON r.id = i.record_id
i.deleted = 0 and r.deleted = 0
and i.standard_name like concat('%', #{param.standardName}, '%')
and r.update_time between #{param.period.begin} and #{param.period.end}
GROUP BY r.task_id, i.record_id, i.standard_id ORDER BY r.update_time DESC

select a.organization_id as depId, a.organization_name as depName, sum(timestampdiff(MINUTE,b.begin_time, a.time)) AS taskTotalTime from inspect_record a left join inspect_task b on a.task_id = b.id ${ew.customSqlSegment}
mapper.select: select a.organization_id as depId, a.organization_name as depName, sum(FLOOR(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (a.time - b.begin_time)) / 60)) AS taskTotalTime from inspect_record a left join inspect_task b on a.task_id = b.id ${ew.customSqlSegment}
mapper.sql:
SELECT sum(timestampdiff(MINUTE ,b.begin_time,a.time)) AS `taskTime`,b.type_id as typeId,b.type_name as inspectionType from inspect_record a left join inspect_task b on a.task_id = b.id
a.time is not null and b.begin_time is not null
and a.create_time between #{param.period.begin} and #{param.period.end}
GROUP BY b.type_id ORDER BY taskTime desc

a.time is not null and b.begin_time is not null

SELECT target_category as name,count(1) as num FROM `inspect_record`
time between #{param.period.begin} and #{param.period.end}
and result='ABNORMAL'
GROUP BY target_category

select organization_id as depId, count(DISTINCT user_id) as personNum from inspect_record
time between #{period.begin} and #{period.end} and organization_id is not null GROUP BY organization_id

SELECT ir.target_category, ir.organization_name, COUNT( ir.id ) as num, COALESCE ( SUM( IF ( ir.result = 'NORMAL', 1, 0 )), 0 ) AS NORMAL_NUM, COALESCE ( SUM( IF ( ir.result = 'ABNORMAL', 1, 0 )), 0 ) AS ABNORMAL_NUM FROM `inspect_record` ir WHERE ir.time BETWEEN #{period.begin} AND #{period.end} GROUP BY ir.target_category, ir.organization_name

SELECT ir.id, ir.`time`, ir.`status`, ir.target_name, ir.target_category, ir.nickname AS username, ir.`result`, ir.task_id, ir.organization_id, ir.organization_name, sum( COALESCE(iri.error_value_flag,0) ) AS errValueNum,
GROUP_CONCAT(iri.item_name SEPARATOR ',') AS errNames
STRING_AGG(iri.item_name, ',') AS errNames
LISTAGG(iri.item_name, ',') AS errNames
GROUP_CONCAT(iri.item_name SEPARATOR ',') AS errNames
FROM inspect_record ir LEFT JOIN inspect_record_item iri ON ( iri.record_id = ir.id ) WHERE ir.status in ('OVER','WAIT_REPAIR','CANCEL_REPAIR')
and ir.target_id = #{param.targetId}
and ir.task_id is not null
and ir.task_id is null
and ir.result = #{param.result}
GROUP BY ir.id, ir.`time`, ir.target_name, ir.nickname, ir.`result`, ir.task_id ORDER BY ir.`time` DESC

SELECT ir.id, ir.target_category, ir.target_id, ir.target_name, if(ir.task_id is null , '临时巡检' , '任务巡检') as inspectMethod, ir.task_id, ir.task_name, ir.user_id, ir.nickname, ir.`time`, ir.`result`,
GROUP_CONCAT(iri.item_name SEPARATOR ',') AS errNames
STRING_AGG(iri.item_name, ',') AS errNames
LISTAGG(iri.item_name, ',') AS errNames
GROUP_CONCAT(iri.item_name SEPARATOR ',') AS errNames
,
GROUP_CONCAT(iri.error_desc SEPARATOR ',') AS errDesc
STRING_AGG(iri.error_desc, ',') AS errDesc
LISTAGG(iri.error_desc, ',') AS errDesc
GROUP_CONCAT(iri.error_desc SEPARATOR ',') AS errDesc
FROM inspect_record ir LEFT JOIN inspect_record_item iri ON ( iri.record_id = ir.id and iri.error_value_flag = 1) WHERE ir.status = 'OVER' and ir.`result` is not null
and ir.`time` between #{param.period.begin} and #{param.period.end}
and ir.`result` = #{param.result}
and ir.`target_name` like concat('%',#{param.keyword},'%')
and ir.task_id is not null
and ir.task_id is null
GROUP BY ir.id ORDER BY ir.`time` DESC
